what: A chrome ring + lightning W logo flies around the page — each frame it closes 9% of the remaining distance toward the placeholder nearest to the screen center among the empty placeholders in each section, scaling to that box’s width (each placeholder can set a Y angle), and shrinks to 0 when no placeholder is on screen. In place it sways slowly with a sine (±.18 rad) and tilts toward the mouse. The chrome reflection is an environment map baked from the skin’s background, text and accent color panels

options.scale: Multiplier applied to placeholder width, default 1
options.ry: Y rotation in place (rad), default 0 — image section is .5, text head is −.4

note: The canvas and environment map are created once when the first anchor attaches and removed when the last anchor detaches. The logo shape (ring + W) is our own shape — to use another logo, change the Shape points in fx.js. The original blends a pose set per anchor by scroll — here it is reduced to being pulled toward the nearest anchor.
